github_budget_first_cycle_caveat.observation: GitHub documents that a newly created hard-stop budget counts only metered usage from its creation date; previous usage is excluded, so a first billing cycle can exceed budget even with stop usage selected.
github_budget_first_cycle_caveat.implication: A future screenshot of a zero budget by itself would not prove absence of pre-existing accrued charges. No budget was created, changed or queried through an undocumented endpoint.

github_storage_accrual_and_logs.observation: GitHub Actions artifact/Packages storage shares an allowance, is metered in GB-hours; deletion cannot undo already accrued usage. Workflow logs and job summaries do not count toward artifact storage allowance. GitHub Free included artifact storage 500 MB; standard public runners free, larger runners charged.
github_storage_accrual_and_logs.exact_workflow_assessment: Workflow uses ubuntu-24.04 standard runner, timeout 12m, no actions/upload-artifact or actions/cache, writes temporary receipt only to /tmp; thus no explicit artifact/cache upload step. This does not attest to account-wide current/accrued storage, payment method or future settings.
